brief.aim: No column is a plausible outcome: InvoiceNo/StockCode/Description are high-cardinality keys or descriptors, Quantity and UnitPrice are transactional measurements, and CustomerID is the source unit. The evident aim (online retail, UCI) is customer segmentation via RFM-style aggregation, so rows are rolled up per customer and clustered; InvoiceDate is used only to compute recency relative to an observation date, so no chronological partition column is declared and CustomerID must be held whole across folds.
brief.repeated_subjects: Each CustomerID appears on many transaction lines; rows are line items, not independent customers.
brief.unit: customer (static entity aggregated from one or more transaction line items)
